title: 第13章 姬无道拜师抬手灭来敌第14章 一个忽悠一个当真
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“前辈就在上面。”
“接下来，你们自己上去吧。”
“我还有些事情需要处理，就不累两位了。”
沈星河停下脚步，随即转身对着姬无道说道。
“好的，多谢沈宗主的带路。”
姬无道客气回道。
“嗯。”点了点头，沈星河便直接离开了。
刚才李如风给了他一枚化神丹，如今他迫不及待想要回去开始突破。
在沈星河走后，姬无道望了一眼灵药峰的顶峰，随后朝着上面走去。
不一会功夫，姬无道就带着莫老来到李如风的院子旁。
“他就是我要找的人？竟然这么年轻！”再发现院子中的李如风后，姬无道心中顿感惊讶。
原本姬无道以为李如风应该是一个白发苍苍的老者，再不济也是一个无比深沉的中年人。
但此刻出现在他面前的李如风，看上去也不过二十来岁，也就比他大上几岁而已。
“此人好生奇怪，我竟然看不透他。”
“莫非我真的错了？”
“能让我看不透的，要么是修为远远高于我，要么有某种遮掩气息的宝物或是秘法。”
“算了，待会接触一番后，就知道此人是不是真的有本事。”
这一刻，莫老个开始对李如风转变了一开始的看法。
但他并没有完全相信李如风，心中还是存在一丝质疑。
很快，姬无道就来到李如风的身旁。

“晚辈姬无道，见过前辈！”
紧接着，姬无道很是恭敬的开口问候道。
听到姬无道的话，李如风这才缓缓睁开双眼。
“听说你找我？”
“说吧，找我何事？”
“我这人不喜欢废话，直接说重点。”
看了一眼姬无道后，李如风淡淡开口道。
面对李如风如此淡然的一面，姬无道不仅没有反感，反而更加认定李如风并非常人。
“既如此，晚辈便直言了。”
“我对天机一道略有了解。”
“之前我给自己算了一下，发现有对我很重要的机缘之人出现。”
“现在我已经确定，前辈就是我的机缘之人。”
“我不远千里前来拜见前辈，就是希望前辈能够收我为徒。”
“还望前辈能够收下我！”
姬无道说完，直接就是朝着李如风跪了下去。
“少主，你！”这一幕，把一旁的莫老给彻底惊到了。
他跟了姬无道这么久，从来就没有见过姬无道给什么人跪下过。
即便是玄州那些大人物，姬无道最多也仅仅是拱拱手而已。
“莫老，这是我的事，你站在一旁就好。”
content_en:
"Senior is right up there."
"Next, go up yourselves."
"I still have some things to deal with, so I won't bore you two."
Shen Xinghe stopped, then turned to Ji Wudao and said.
"Okay, thank you Sect Master Shen for your guidance."
Ji Wudao replied politely.
"Yes." Shen Xinghe nodded and left directly.
Li Rufeng had just given him a magic pill, and now he couldn't wait to go back and start making breakthroughs.
After Shen Xinghe left, Ji Wudao glanced at the top of the Spiritual Medicine Peak and then walked up.
After a while, Ji Wudao took Mr. Mo to Li Rufeng's yard.
"He is the person I am looking for? He is so young!" After discovering Li Rufeng in the yard again, Ji Wudao was surprised.
Originally, Ji Wudao thought that Li Rufeng should be a gray-haired old man, or at least an extremely deep middle-aged man.
But Li Rufeng, who appeared in front of him at this moment, looked to be in his twenties, only a few years older than him.
"This man is so strange, I can't see through him."
"Am I really wrong?"
"What makes me unable to see through it is either that the cultivation level is much higher than mine, or there is some kind of treasure or secret method that masks the aura."
"Forget it, after getting in touch with him later, you will know whether this person is really capable."
At this moment, Mr. Mo began to change his initial view of Li Rufeng.
But he didn't completely believe Li Rufeng, and there was still a trace of doubt in his heart.
Soon, Ji Wudao came to Li Rufeng's side.
"Junior Ji Wudao, I have met my senior!"
Immediately afterwards, Ji Wudao greeted him very respectfully.
After hearing Ji Wudao's words, Li Rufeng slowly opened his eyes.
"I heard you were looking for me?"
"Tell me, what do you want from me?"
"I don't like nonsense, I just get to the point."
After taking a look at Ji Wudao, Li Rufeng said calmly.
Facing Li Rufeng's indifferent side, Ji Wudao not only did not feel disgusted, but even more convinced that Li Rufeng was not an ordinary person.
"In that case, this junior will speak out."
"I know a little about Tianji."
"I did some calculations for myself before and found that someone very important to me appeared by chance."
"Now I have determined that senior is my perfect match."
"I traveled thousands of miles to meet my senior, just hoping that he would accept me as his disciple."
"I hope senior can accept me!"
After Ji Wudao finished speaking, he knelt down directly towards Li Rufeng.
"Young Master, you!" This scene completely shocked Mr. Mo beside him.
He had been following Ji Wudao for so long, and he had never seen Ji Wudao kneel down for anyone.
Even for the big shots in Xuanzhou, Ji Wudao could only give them away.
"Mr. Mo, this is my business, just stand aside."
